evidence.reason: The test makes the second lock via a bare write_text("") at line 637, so its mode is umask-dependent. Under umask 002 it is created 0o664; the surrounding tests show lock_identity rejects group/world-writable locks and only controller_lock() normalizes the mode to 0o600. The first lock is created through controller_lock(), but this second one is not, so line 641 can raise LiveBindingRefused before the inode comparison. Explicitly chmod'ing the fixture to 0o600 is the smallest deterministic repair and does not change intended behavior.
